text:
alex_chen: Heads up — onboarding with Acme Health next week for a private VPC deploy. Need a concise checklist for network egress, KMS integration, RBAC mapping to their AD, audit log retention, and vuln triage/IR expectations. TL;DR: what should be ON by default vs opt-in? :grimacing:

sec_ops_bot: Automated note: scan of current playbooks done — missing explicit egress whitelist template and no KMS key policy example for cross-account restricted use. See below.

maria_garcia: High level: default-deny egress + explicit allowlist for patch repos, container registries, telemetry endpoints (SIEM), and our control plane. KMS: require a customer-managed key (CMK) with a narrow key policy; we never hold the key material. RBAC: map AD groups to our platform roles, avoid granting admin to service accounts.

samir_patel: For vuln triage — for private deploys we need weekly vulnerability scans + one-off emergency scans triggered by infra CVEs. Triage flow:
1) Triage owner (sec oncall)
2) Assess exploitability (network exposure + credentials)
3) Apply workaround (iptables / network policy) if patch can't be applied immediately
4) Patch and verify

kyle_dobson: Quick network policy snippet (k8s) we use as a starting point — deny all egress, allow only required hosts:

```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-egress-by-default
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress: []
```

Then attach namespace-level allow policies for registries and our metrics/SIEM endpoints.

lina_zhou: On KMS key policy: require the key to have a condition for request source VPC or IAM principal. Example (conceptual):
```
"Condition": {
  "StringEquals": {"aws:sourceVpc": "vpc-1234"}
}
```
Also enable key rotation and ensure CloudHSM/KMS audit logs are forwarded to the customer's SIEM — we only store key identifiers in our control plane, never key material.

alex_chen: AD/LDAP mapping — do we have a recommended claim set for SAML/SCIM? They want groups in AD to map to our internal roles (viewer/operator/admin). Any pitfalls?

maria_garcia: Use SCIM group sync for mappings. Pitfall: nested groups and name collisions — prefer explicit group IDs if possible. Minimum privileges:
- viewer: read-only dashboards + logs
- operator: can deploy/scale but no RBAC or billing changes
- admin: full access (rare)
Also enforce MFA for admin AD group and restrict admin role membership with periodic attestation.

sec_ops_bot: Note: found an image with a vuln reference (CVE-2025-9876) in their internal registry. Marked as medium exploitability due to constrained network exposure but needs backport on older images.

samir_patel: Action from vuln triage: if CVE affects runtime libs, mitigate with an egress block to package mirrors so cluster can't pull compromised images, and schedule immediate rebuild with patched base image. Inform customer via the onboarding channel and list affected namespaces.

kyle_dobson: Audit logging: default retention = 90 days on the platform for full request/response logs; for regulated customers set to 365 days or forward to customer SIEM. Ensure logs are integrity-protected (HMAC) and include KMS key ID, principal, route, and model version.

lina_zhou: Incident response playbook items for private deploys:
- Detection: SIEM alert or our agent -> create incident ticket
- Contain: apply network policy deny-egress for affected namespaces, revoke corresponding service tokens, rotate customer-facing keys
- Eradicate: patch images, rotate KMS key (if compromise suspected), reconcile audit trail
- Recover: validate with replay tests, remove containment rules, postmortem

maria_garcia: One more operational control: bring-your-own-keys (BYOK) requirement for PHI customers. We enforce a policy where private deploys handling PHI must enable BYOK and setup cross-account trust for backup/rotation workflows.

alex_chen: Thanks — can someone drop a compiled checklist and the allowlist template into the onboarding doc? I’ll coordinate with Acme infra. @maria_garcia @kyle_dobson

maria_garcia: On it. I’ll add the RBAC mapping template and a SCIM example.

kyle_dobson: I’ll add the k8s network policy allowlist and sample iptables fallback commands for pre-k8s hosts.

lina_zhou: I’ll draft the KMS key policy snippet + audit forwarding instructions and include the CVE triage notes.
